French Billionaire Olivier Bouygues Faces Trial for Killing Protected Birds

French billionaire Olivier Bouygues is on trial for allegedly ordering the killing of protected birds on his private hunting estate in France. Prosecutors accuse Bouygues of instructing workers to eliminate protected species on his property. The case involves allegations of a 'mass grave' of wildlife found on the estate. The trial is taking place in France.
